method: Surface records were confirmed from files listed in the row 019 FULL_READ_MANIFEST. The generated all-surface structural inventory was used only for navigation.
limitation_statement: This file is a surface-specific active-code Atlas slice, not acceptance of the generated all-surface active-code Atlas as semantic truth.
surface_limitation: This pass adjudicates checked calendar-reference import/projection authority and bounded nested-authority rejection for selected native financial/event calendar files. It does not adjudicate live calendar/network fetches, market-data APIs, candidate formation, capital sizing, trading instructions, or full financial-calendar implementation maturity.

records.title: Checked calendar reference manifests reject hidden runtime decision authority before projection
adjudication_notes: The existing Tier A family was extended before source repair to reject runtime-decision authority keys nested inside calendar manifest artifacts and layers.
The pre-repair targeted test failed because load_manifest rejected forbidden authority keys only at the top-level manifest mapping.
The bounded repair makes forbidden manifest-authority detection recursive across manifest mappings and list/tuple containers before building typed reference bundle contracts.
The financial_event_calendar_authority_surface proof block command was repaired to include PYTHONPATH=src in this clean bundle.
non_claims: Does not prove live financial-calendar fetches or online source ingestion.
Does not upgrade the whole 5.4 surface to implemented.
Does not authorise candidate formation, capital sizing, broker/order, risk-policy, dependency, or runtime trading behaviour.
